description.value: Mud Sharks Coffee Bar is a downtown Courtenay café known for fresh, healthy food and 49th Parallel specialty coffee. It stands out for its explicit commitment to gluten-free and plant-based menu options, making it a welcoming stop for diet-conscious touring cyclists passing through the Comox Valley. The café operates under a fast, friendly service model and offers online ordering via Square.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 33m; bollard at 96m. Total: 4 spaces.
